Personality: Eposognatos, a prominent figure of the Trocmi, Generous, flamboyant, lover of single combat and thunderous war cries; adorned with golden torcs and devout before Druidic omens, leading devastating shock charges with broadswords.
Background: Eposognatos owes allegiance to the Galatian Celtic Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Trocmi. Historical Record: A Trocmian chief and friend of Pergamon. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
